verdict.rationale: Fivetran has a documented REST API for provisioning/managing connectors, transformations, and account settings, plus a separate MCP server that exposes read/write/delete operations (sync status, connection management, copying connections) mirroring some dashboard actions. However, there is no explicit documentation claiming full UI/API parity, and features like dashboard alerting configuration, hybrid deployment agent management, or usage/billing views are only shown via the dashboard UI in the evidence, not confirmed as API-accessible. missing for 10: explicit parity statement, API coverage for dashboard-only features (alerts config, hybrid agent UI, usage analytics), independent confirmation of completeness.
